stem: What operative approach is used for a plunging ranula?

options.text: Intra-oral excision including the sublingual gland of origin
Immediate drainage of a lymph node abscess

explanation: Intra-oral excision including the sublingual gland of origin is the operative approach for a plunging ranula.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because expectant management is not the operative approach described for a plunging ranula.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because external neck excision alone does not address the sublingual gland of origin.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because definitive management is intra-oral excision including the sublingual gland of origin.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because lymph node abscess drainage is unrelated to plunging ranula.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because thyroid surgery is not used to treat plunging ranula.
